    <title>Release 5.17.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Release v5.17.0</h1>
<h2>New Model additions</h2>
<h3>HYV4</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/648777072-e6ed85ee-eb1d-40eb-a0d4-c649f6337ca9.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..s58uCTxSl-FHA-Hvsu-9P8J9sXXqGaQpZdTd8DdDQP8"><img width="1503" height="827" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/648777072-e6ed85ee-eb1d-40eb-a0d4-c649f6337ca9.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..s58uCTxSl-FHA-Hvsu-9P8J9sXXqGaQpZdTd8DdDQP8" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 827px;"></a>
<p>Hy4-Preview is a 780B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model that activates 49B parameters per<br>
token. Each MoE layer holds 256 routed experts plus one always-active shared expert and routes every<br>
token to 8 of them. The context window is 1M tokens.</p>
<p>The architecture combines four features:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA)</strong> compresses keys and values into a low-rank latent<br>
(<code>kv_lora_rank</code>) that <code>kv_b_proj</code> expands back to one key/value per query head.</li>
<li><strong>DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)</strong> selects <code>index_topk</code> keys per query with a lightweight indexer.<br>
Following <a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2603.12201" rel="nofollow">IndexShare</a>, only the layers marked <code>"full"</code><br>
in <code>indexer_types</code> run an indexer; <code>"shared"</code> layers reuse the previous full layer's selection.</li>
<li><strong>Gated MLA with learnable attention sinks</strong>, where each head owns a sink logit that participates<br>
in the softmax and contributes no value, as in <a href="/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.17.0/gpt_oss">GPT-OSS</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Independent Hyper-Connections (iHC)</strong> replace the plain residual path with <code>hc_mult</code> parallel<br>
residual streams that are collapsed before, and redistributed after, every sublayer.</li>
</ul>
<p>The implementation does not execute the multi-token prediction (MTP) layers. Released checkpoints<br>
keep those weights so that other runtimes can use them for speculative decoding; they are ignored<br>
at load time.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/hy_v4" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add h4 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5319755398" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48473" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48473/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48473">#48473</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/ArthurZucker/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/ArthurZucker">@ArthurZucker</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48473" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48473/hovercard">#48473</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>VibeVoice</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/648777689-29ccea01-a855-4d4f-a6af-61bc4fc883a4.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ALdL1S8rrA4WNoTc_JSm385378ELavYcfvVDFKSDjE0"><img width="2000" height="1110" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/648777689-29ccea01-a855-4d4f-a6af-61bc4fc883a4.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..ALdL1S8rrA4WNoTc_JSm385378ELavYcfvVDFKSDjE0" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1110px;"></a>
<p><a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2508.19205" rel="nofollow">VibeVoice</a> is a novel framework for synthesizing high-fidelity, long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing a next-token diffusion approach within a Large Language Model (LLM) structure. It's designed to capture the authentic conversational "vibe" and is particularly suited for generating audio content like podcasts and multi-participant audiobooks.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/vibevoice" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Implement VibeVoice  (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="3366773640" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/40546" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/40546/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/40546">#40546</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/pengzhiliang/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/pengzhiliang">@pengzhiliang</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/40546" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/40546/hovercard">#40546</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>NeoMME</h3>
<p>NeoMME is a family of efficient 260M and 800M parameter multimodal-native multilingual foundation encoders from H Company. It processes multilingual text tokens and raw image patches in a single bidirectional Transformer encoder, without a separately pretrained vision tower or causal language model.</p>
<p>NeoMME-Retriever is a model fine-tuned from the NeoMME backbone for visual document retrieval with joint late-interaction and dense objectives. It takes text queries and documents (text or page screenshots) and produces multi-vector embeddings for MeanMaxSim scoring (late-interaction) and mean-pooled embeddings for cosine similarity (dense).</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/neomme" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add NeoMME and NeoMME-Retriever (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5161189368" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47992" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47992/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47992">#47992</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/tonywu71/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/tonywu71">@tonywu71</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47992" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47992/hovercard">#47992</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Fun-ASR-Nano</h3>
<p>Fun-ASR-Nano is an 800M-parameter end-to-end speech recognition model developed by Alibaba DAMO Academy's FunAudioLLM team. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on Chinese, English, and Japanese ASR benchmarks while being significantly smaller than comparable models.</p>
<p>Key features are</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Chinese, English, and Japanese</strong>, including 7 Chinese dialects and 26 regional accents</li>
<li><strong>Hotword customization</strong> for domain-specific vocabulary</li>
<li><strong>Native punctuation</strong> output (no separate punctuation model needed)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/fun_asr_nano" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add Fun-ASR-Nano model (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4511343833" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46180" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46180/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46180">#46180</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/LauraGPT/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/LauraGPT">@LauraGPT</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46180" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46180/hovercard">#46180</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>KimiLinear</h3>
<p>Kimi Linear is a hybrid linear attention architecture from Moonshot AI, introduced in<br>
<a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2510.26692" rel="nofollow">Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture</a>.</p>
<p>At its core is <strong>Kimi Delta Attention (KDA)</strong>, a refinement of <a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2412.06464" rel="nofollow">Gated DeltaNet</a><br>
that gives each key channel its own forget gate, so the recurrent state decays per channel instead of per head. KDA is<br>
used in most layers; every fourth layer keeps a full-attention block that reuses DeepSeek-V3's Multi-head Latent<br>
Attention (MLA), and the feed-forward blocks are DeepSeek-V3-style MoE with a shared expert.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/kimi_linear" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Kimi linear (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5233626621" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48250" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48250/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48250">#48250</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/remi-or/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/remi-or">@remi-or</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48250" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48250/hovercard">#48250</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>Canary</h3>
<p>Canary-1B-v2, a fast, robust multilingual model for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) and Speech-to-Text Translation (AST):</p>
<p>Canary reuses the <a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2305.05084" rel="nofollow">Fast Conformer</a> encoder from <a href="/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.17.0/parakeet.md">Parakeet</a> (loaded through [<code>ParakeetEncoder</code>] / [<code>ParakeetEncoderConfig</code>]) and pairs it with a Transformer decoder that uses fixed sinusoidal positional embeddings, cross-attention to the encoder outputs and tied input/output embeddings. The task is selected through a decoder prompt prefix built by [<code>CanaryProcessor</code>] of the form <code>&lt;|startofcontext|&gt; &lt;|startoftranscript|&gt; &lt;|emo:undefined|&gt; &lt;source_lang&gt; &lt;target_lang&gt; &lt;pnc|nopnc&gt; &lt;|noitn|&gt; &lt;|notimestamp|&gt; &lt;|nodiarize|&gt;</code>, where <code>source_lang == target_lang</code> selects transcription and otherwise selects translation.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/canary" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>model: Add NVIDIA Canary-1B-v2 to Transformers (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4720142655" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46825" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46825/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46825">#46825</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/harshaljanjani/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/harshaljanjani">@harshaljanjani</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46825" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46825/hovercard">#46825</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>NeuCodec</h3>
<p>The NeuCodec model was proposed in <a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2509.09550" rel="nofollow">Finite Scalar Quantization Enables Redundant and Transmission-Robust Neural Audio Compression at Low Bit-rates</a>.</p>
<p>NeuCodec is a neural audio codec extending on XCodec2. It takes advantage of the following features:</p>
<ul>
<li>Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) quantisation resulting in a <strong>single codebook</strong>, making it ideal for downstream modeling with Speech Language Models.</li>
<li>Trained with CC data such that there are <strong>no Non-Commercial data restrictions</strong>.</li>
<li>At 50 tokens/sec and 16 bits per token, the overall bit-rate is <strong>0.8kbps</strong>.</li>
<li>The codec takes in 16kHz input and outputs <strong>24kHz</strong> using an <strong>upsampling decoder</strong>.</li>
<li>The FSQ encoding scheme allows for bit-level error resistance suitable for unreliable and noisy channels.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/neucodec" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add support for NeuCodec (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4829753133" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47143" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47143/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47143">#47143</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/harryjulian/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/harryjulian">@harryjulian</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47143" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47143/hovercard">#47143</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Breaking changes</h2>
<p>Vision rotary embeddings (2D/3D) have been standardized into a unified RoPE frequency computation module, so users with custom vision models relying on attention-layer-level or model-specific RoPE grid interleaving logic must migrate to the new centralized <code>modeling_rope_utils.py</code> implementation.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 Vision (2d/3d) rotary embeddings  (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5191578921" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48105" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48105/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48105">#48105</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/zucchini-nlp/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/zucchini-nlp">@zucchini-nlp</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Generation</h2>
<p>Generation improvements include a performance optimization that avoids unnecessary accelerator synchronization on every decode step (reducing per-step overhead), and a fix to prevent unconditional downloading of remote hub files during generation. Several correctness fixes were also applied, including enforcing auto-compile cache checks for encoder-decoder models, standardizing <code>past_key_values</code> naming in AfMoE, and resolving flaky export and integration test failures.</p>
<ul>
<li>[<code>Generate</code>] Avoid unconditionally downloading remote hub file (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387375556" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48620" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48620/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48620">#48620</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/vasqu/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/vasqu">@vasqu</a> in [<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5387375556" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48620" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48620/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48620">#48620</a>]</li>
<li>[generate] stop synchronizing the accelerator on every decode step (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5153450602" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47975" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47975/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47975">#47975</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/SunMarc/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/SunMarc">@SunMarc</a> in [<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5153450602" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47975" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47975/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47975">#47975</a>]</li>
<li>[AfMoE] Standardize past_key_values argument naming across forward and generate (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5298559588" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48430" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48430/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48430">#48430</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/shenhuaqingshi/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/shenhuaqingshi">@shenhuaqingshi</a> in [<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5298559588" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48430" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48430/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48430">#48430</a>]</li>
<li>Fix MTP generation test regex gate for escaped layer ignore keys (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5166290830" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48003" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/issues/48003/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48003">#48003</a>) (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5239541002" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48262" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48262/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48262">#48262</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Noxtimo/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Noxtimo">@Noxtimo</a> in [<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5239541002" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48262" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48262/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48262">#48262</a>]</li>

    <title>Release v5.16.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Release v5.16.1</h1>
<p>This is a special release as we include GLM! (and a few small fixes)</p>
<h1>GLM-5.3-Flash</h1>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641638039-17bc9c29-758b-44c8-8230-42f945ded209.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..eZQ8kFj-tkYNudDu7a5khh01ut75s-1hy9lBopeHy3s"><img width="2000" height="1247" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641638039-17bc9c29-758b-44c8-8230-42f945ded209.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..eZQ8kFj-tkYNudDu7a5khh01ut75s-1hy9lBopeHy3s" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1247px;"></a>
<p>GLM-5.3-Flash, the first <strong>natively multimodal model</strong> in the GLM-5 series. With 320B total parameters and just 18B active parameters, it outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks.</p>
<p>GLM-5.3-Flash starts from a newly trained base model, with its architecture and training recipe redesigned around capability and efficiency. For the first time in the GLM series, we introduce a hybrid architecture combining sparse and linear attention, sharply reducing long-context serving costs while preserving precise long-context capabilities. The model also adopts Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) to further improve scaling efficiency. Together with our latest <strong>30T-token</strong> multimodal pre-training corpus, these changes enable GLM-5.3-Flash to deliver more intelligence with less compute.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/glm5_next" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>[Glm 5.3 Flash] GLM 5.3 Flash Support (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5257892093" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48342" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48342/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48342">#48342</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Dovis01/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Dovis01">@Dovis01</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48342" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48342/hovercard">#48342</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Small patch fixes</h2>
<p>Mainly BC behavior for TP and pinning a hf kernel for security reasons 🤗</p>
<ul>
<li>Restore BC for the tensor-parallel API (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5247688388" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48300" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48300/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48300">#48300</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/ArthurZucker/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/ArthurZucker">@ArthurZucker</a></li>
<li>Fix kernel commit and repo paths for ESMFold2 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5215379210" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48186" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48186/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48186">#48186</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Rocketknight1/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Rocketknight1">@Rocketknight1</a></li>
</ul>

    <updated>2026-08-26T15:03:33Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases/tag/v5.16.0"/>
    <title>Release: v5.16.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Release v5.16.0</h1>
<h2>New Model additions</h2>
<h3>Qwen4-Exp</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641553234-c838b5ba-ffea-42da-baa9-3f66178e3671.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..tTbHSqLCKazrxOO6nkkOIKk5LHKZZjlc9BgH5iYVNDE"><img width="2000" height="618" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641553234-c838b5ba-ffea-42da-baa9-3f66178e3671.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..tTbHSqLCKazrxOO6nkkOIKk5LHKZZjlc9BgH5iYVNDE" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 618px;"></a>
<p>Qwen4-Exp builds on Qwen3.5's hybrid text and multimodal architecture with three key components: GatedResidual (GR), Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA), and Per-Layer Embedding (PLE).</p>
<p>GR is a Qwen-developed residual architecture that combines Hyper-Connection with GatedNorm. It mixes multiple residual streams with fine-grained elementwise gating before each attention and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) block, then controls how much of the block output is injected back into each stream.</p>
<p>QSA uses multiple query heads to score compressed key blocks, selects the most relevant contiguous token blocks, and keeps the incomplete trailing block uncompressed. This block-level selection reduces indexing overhead and improves memory locality for long sequences. Combined with Gated DeltaNet, QSA makes Qwen4-Exp the first hybrid architecture to integrate linear and sparse attention, substantially improving inference efficiency for long-context workloads.</p>
<p>PLE enriches selected decoder layers with layer-specific lexical features derived from hashed token n-grams and a dilated depthwise convolution.</p>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/qwen4_exp" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add Qwen4Exp model (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5256489666" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48337" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48337/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48337">#48337</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48337" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48337/hovercard">#48337</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>GraniteSpeech5</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641558162-106ef712-9f45-43c9-98b7-ce6e4a7c136d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..WI6cQSohJgk9qgAW_vqL_PEQhBNjPGNTGHDhdL92Mno"><img width="1600" height="1440" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/73884904/641558162-106ef712-9f45-43c9-98b7-ce6e4a7c136d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..WI6cQSohJgk9qgAW_vqL_PEQhBNjPGNTGHDhdL92Mno" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1440px;"></a>
<p>Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC is a lightweight (~470M parameters) conformer encoder for automatic speech recognition, trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) on BPE targets. It is a fast, encoder-only member of the <a href="https://huggingface.co/papers/2505.08699" rel="nofollow">Granite Speech</a> family: transcription requires a single forward pass followed by greedy CTC decoding, with no autoregressive decoder.</p>
<p>Architecturally, it extends the Granite Speech conformer CTC encoder with:</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>Frame stacking + block-wise time subsampling</strong>: the feature extractor stacks pairs of log-mel(+delta) frames (2x), and the first two conformer blocks each subsample time by 2 through a stride-2 depthwise convolution (with a mean-pooled residual), for a total 8x time reduction at 10 ms mel hop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Block attention with Shaw's relative positional embeddings</strong>: attention is computed over fixed-size blocks (the sequence is right-padded to a whole number of blocks, with padded frames masked out), using separate bias-free query/key/value projections.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Self-conditioned CTC</strong>: the CTC posteriors of the middle layer are projected and fed back into the hidden states, and the CTC head is shared between this mid-layer self-conditioning and the final prediction.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/granite_speech5" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>

<h3>Step3p7</h3>
<p>Step-3.7-Flash was proposed in <a href="https://static.stepfun.com/blog/step-3.7-flash/" rel="nofollow">Step 3.7 Flash</a> by StepFun. It is a 198B-parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model, pairing a 196B-parameter MoE language backbone with a 1.8B-parameter vision encoder for native image understanding.</p>
<p>StepFun hasn't published a technical report for Step-3.7-Flash, so the details below are drawn from the released checkpoint's configuration rather than a paper.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Sparse MoE decoder</strong>: all but the first 3 decoder layers route through a MoE block of 288 routed experts (top-8 per token) plus a single shared expert. The router scores experts with a sigmoid and a learned per-expert bias instead of an auxiliary load-balancing loss, the same strategy as <a href="/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.16.0/deepseek_v3">DeepSeek-V3</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Gated attention</strong>: each attention layer adds an extra projection whose sigmoid output gates the attention output per head, before the output projection — the same <em>Gated Attention</em> mechanism used in <a href="/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.16.0/qwen3_next">Qwen3-Next</a>. A subset of layers use fewer heads and a sliding window instead of full attention.</li>
<li><strong>Multi-token prediction</strong>: some checkpoints ship extra decoder layers trained for multi-token prediction, which [<code>~GenerationMixin.generate</code>] can use for speculative decoding via <code>use_mtp=True</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Vision encoder</strong>: a SigLIP-style ViT with 2-D rotary position embeddings and a learned per-layer scale on the attention and MLP branches. Its output is downsampled 4x by two stride-2 convolutions before a linear projector maps it into the text model's hidden size.</li>
<li><strong>Dynamic image tiling</strong>: instead of a fixed tile grid, the image processor picks its tiling window from each image's own aspect ratio, producing one downscaled global view plus zero or more local high-resolution crops per image.</li>
</ul>

<h3>ESMC and ESMFold2</h3>
<p>ESMC and ESMFold2 are new state-of-the-art protein language and folding models from BioHub. ESMC is trained with a masked language modeling objective, and it can be easily transferred to sequence and token classification tasks for proteins. Checkpoints exist in various sizes, from 300M parameters up to 6B parameters. It works as a drop-in replacement for older ESM-2 and ESM-3 models, with significantly higher accuracy.</p>
<p>ESMFold2 is a state-of-the-art protein folding model which produces high accuracy predictions. It uses an iterated diffusion approach that is significantly different from the original ESMFold, offering huge improvements in accuracy for more complex structures.</p>

<h2>Attention</h2>
<p>Several attention-related bug fixes were made in this release, including correcting a SigLIP2 documentation typo, fixing Flash/SDPA attention dispatch tests for xcodec2 and ROCm RDNA GPUs, resolving a GPT2 cross-attention mask being silently discarded, and enabling SDPA support declaration in <code>TimmWrapper</code>. Per-layer cache configuration and attention-mask selection support was also introduced, allowing models with heterogeneous layer configurations to use distinct <code>sliding_window</code>, <code>attention_chunk_size</code>, and <code>number_of_conv_states</code> values per layer.</p>

    <title>Patch release: v5.15.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Patch release v5.15.1</h1>
<p>This patch most notably solves a few issues with DFlash and MTP candidate generators, as well as an issue where images could sometimes not be processed on accelerator if using Lanczos filter.</p>
<p>It contains the following commits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Fix DFlash candidate token device mismatch with device_map="auto" (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5110855455" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47877" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47877/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47877">#47877</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/sywangyi/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/sywangyi">@sywangyi</a> and <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
<li>Align logit distributions for CandidateGenerators using sampling  (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5169045635" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48007" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48007/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48007">#48007</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
<li>Fix MTP config when mlp_layer_types is absent (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5170138612" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48015" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48015/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48015">#48015</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
<li>Fallback from 'lanczos' to 'bicubic' when on cuda (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5171019231" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/48026" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/48026/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/48026">#48026</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/zucchini-nlp/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/zucchini-nlp">@zucchini-nlp</a></li>
<li>Fix gemma4 video to device (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5118377601" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47896" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47896/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47896">#47896</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/guarin/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/guarin">@guarin</a></li>
</ul></content>

    <content type="html"><h1>Release v5.15.0</h1>
<h2>New Model additions</h2>
<h3>Meta Muse Glimmer</h3>
<p>Muse Glimmer, released today, is Meta’s new multimodal model, especially designed for agentic use cases. Distilled from Muse to 30B parameters, and released under the Apache 2.0 license, it can be deployed to local setups for privacy-aware applications such as coding, document analysis, personal assistants, Claw- or Hermes-like setups.</p>
<p>Muse Glimmer is a dense 30B parameter model consisting of:</p>
<ul>
<li>2B ViT-style encoder for vision (Perception Encoder)</li>
<li>28B parameter text decoder</li>
</ul>
<p>We're covering it in the following blogpost: <a href="http://hf.co/blog/muse-glimmer" rel="nofollow">http://hf.co/blog/muse-glimmer</a></p>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633659176-3d8e548e-f84f-4269-8bd0-a12722d7ab01.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..oN22cET9up_fEW__qwOK_hNtqrqXxqj1adV-RGDGbWU"><img width="960" height="1787" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633659176-3d8e548e-f84f-4269-8bd0-a12722d7ab01.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..oN22cET9up_fEW__qwOK_hNtqrqXxqj1adV-RGDGbWU" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1787px;"></a>
<hr>
<h3>GraniteMoeSWA &amp; GraniteSWA</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633552478-2c2b87f0-466a-413a-a4be-25ceae49c9a5.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..dyJbR9burkTBpenSYCSUfEoVP4l4LQeBbZ8kkZJf_aQ"><img width="1013" height="389" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633552478-2c2b87f0-466a-413a-a4be-25ceae49c9a5.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..dyJbR9burkTBpenSYCSUfEoVP4l4LQeBbZ8kkZJf_aQ" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 389px;"></a>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/granitemoe_swa" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add Granite-swa and Granitemoe-swa model support (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4840500392" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47179" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179">#47179</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/daviswer/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/daviswer">@daviswer</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179/hovercard">#47179</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/granite_swa" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add Granite-swa and Granitemoe-swa model support (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4840500392" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47179" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179">#47179</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/daviswer/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/daviswer">@daviswer</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47179/hovercard">#47179</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>A.X-K1 &amp; A.X-K2</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633554592-a20665bb-43ee-4af0-bb6f-80da495ea4f3.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..3OjGzrYllcGCfyI1avnb7UOWvsAViLe7Fsh61VH1nPk"><img width="580" height="319" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633554592-a20665bb-43ee-4af0-bb6f-80da495ea4f3.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..3OjGzrYllcGCfyI1avnb7UOWvsAViLe7Fsh61VH1nPk" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 319px;"></a>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/axk2" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add AXK2 from SKT (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4972320585" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47528" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47528/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47528">#47528</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/vasqu/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/vasqu">@vasqu</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47528" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47528/hovercard">#47528</a></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/axk1" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>add_axk1 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4735758560" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46867" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46867/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46867">#46867</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/kmswin1/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/kmswin1">@kmswin1</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46867" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46867/hovercard">#46867</a></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>Cosmos3 Edge</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633555155-16e41b90-11a5-4f22-8c56-11162b9c0a5f.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..E7pgaib8u_mbdLHw-OJirUwevruEGksNV8oXfXqQUto"><img width="1280" height="720" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/30755778/633555155-16e41b90-11a5-4f22-8c56-11162b9c0a5f.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..E7pgaib8u_mbdLHw-OJirUwevruEGksNV8oXfXqQUto" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 720px;"></a>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/cosmos3_edge" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add Cosmos3 Edge model support (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4841670766" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47181" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47181/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47181">#47181</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/atharvajoshi10/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/atharvajoshi10">@atharvajoshi10</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47181" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47181/hovercard">#47181</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Breaking changes</h2>
<p>Kernels are now opt-in rather than mandatory for linear attention models (Mamba, GDN, Conv-only, etc.), so users who relied on automatic kernel selection must explicitly enable kernels to maintain previous behavior.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 [<code>Kernels</code>] Refactor all linear attn models &amp; native kernels fallback (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5013621706" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47630" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47630/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47630">#47630</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/vasqu/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/vasqu">@vasqu</a></li>
</ul>
<p>The cache cropping API now only accepts negative values (relative offsets) instead of absolute sizes, so users calling crop methods directly must update their code to pass negative values accordingly.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 [cache] Cropping can only be done with negative values (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5045938270" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47720" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47720/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47720">#47720</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
</ul>
<p>T5 and its model family (MT5, LongT5, etc.) now support SDPA and other attention backends via <code>ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS</code>, meaning the default attention implementation may change and users relying on the previous eager-only path should explicitly set <code>attn_implementation="eager"</code> if needed.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 Enable SDPA (and other attention backends) for T5 and propagate to the T5 family (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4790560372" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47014" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47014/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47014">#47014</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/jiqing-feng/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/jiqing-feng">@jiqing-feng</a></li>
</ul>
<p>Several small private helper functions (e.g., <code>_is_url</code>, <code>_build_image_tokens</code>) have been removed from multimodal processor files, so users or downstream libraries that imported these private functions directly must remove or replace those references.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 Processors update the rest (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4638903423" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46556" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46556/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46556">#46556</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/zucchini-nlp/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/zucchini-nlp">@zucchini-nlp</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Attention</h2>
<p>This release includes several attention fixes and improvements, including correcting Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) cache compression, optimizing Flash Attention max sequence length computation in vision models, and fixing bugs in CTRL flex-attention and SDPA prefill with position bias. Additional changes refactor linear attention models for better maintainability, make Gemma 4's heterogeneous attention config explicit, and improve MPS support via metal-flash-sdpa integration.</p>

<h2>Vision</h2>
<p>Vision improvements in this release include performance optimizations such as faster image preprocessing for vision-language models (GLM4V, MiniMaxM3-VL, and others) by eliminating redundant tensor copies, and more efficient Flash Attention variable-length paths by precomputing maximum sequence lengths once per forward pass. Several bug fixes were also applied, including correcting dtype alignment in Kosmos2/Kosmos2_5 embedding merges, fixing a position-embedding initialization fallback in Phi4Multimodal, resolving PIL resize parity in Hunyuan-VL, and patching stop-sequence handling in the image-text-to-text pipeline.</p>

<h2>Cache</h2>
<p>Several cache-related bugs were fixed, including correcting NemotronH's missing <code>"mlp"</code> layer-type mapping, resolving recurrent-layer padding masks being skipped during chunked prefill and cache continuation for hybrid models, and fixing assisted decoding for models with <code>EncoderDecoderCache</code> and OlmoHybrid.     <title>Patch release: v5.14.1</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Patch release v5.14.1</h1>
<p>This patch solves a few issues which appeared when integrating Inkling model, most notably an issue affecting models using EncoderDecoderCache during assisted generation. It also fixes an issue that could appear during prefill with StaticCache and sdpa without padding for Inkling which uses a position_bias.<br>
It contains the following commits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Fix sdpa prefill with position_bias (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4899305801" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47359" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47359/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47359">#47359</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
<li>Fix assisted decoding for models with EncoderDecoder cache &amp; OlmoHybrid (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4899555117" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47361" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47361/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47361">#47361</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a></li>
<li>[FP8] Bump kernels version (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4894295731" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47344" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47344/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47344">#47344</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/vasqu/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/vasqu">@vasqu</a></li>
<li>Fix deepgemm on multiple devices (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4884642885" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47323" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47323/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47323">#47323</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/IlyasMoutawwakil/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/IlyasMoutawwakil">@IlyasMoutawwakil</a></li>
</ul></content>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/155220641/v5.14.0</id>

    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases/tag/v5.14.0"/>
    <title>Release v5.14.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h1>Release v5.14.0</h1>
<h2>New Model additions</h2>
<h3>Inkling (fresh from Thinking Machines): 975B total, 41B active</h3>
<ul>
<li>Add Inkling model <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4895230194" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47347" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47347/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47347">#47347</a> by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/molbap/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/molbap">@molbap</a> <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Cyrilvallez/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Cyrilvallez">@Cyrilvallez</a> <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/eustlb/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/eustlb">@eustlb</a> and <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/zucchini-nlp/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/zucchini-nlp">@zucchini-nlp</a></li>
</ul>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622245190-051f819a-512f-4987-9bee-6e2fa2af3db7.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..-SFc_hmo-WPUjeTt58LRac1rYxvWI11aAN_-7VUBPtw"><img width="2000" height="1125" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622245190-051f819a-512f-4987-9bee-6e2fa2af3db7.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..-SFc_hmo-WPUjeTt58LRac1rYxvWI11aAN_-7VUBPtw" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1125px;"></a>
<p>Inkling is a general-purpose multimodal model that accepts text, image and audio inputs and<br>
generates text outputs. It is intended for use in English and other languages, and across<br>
multiple coding languages. The model is designed to be used by developers building AI-<br>
powered applications, including agentic and tool-use systems, coding assistants, chatbots, and<br>
retrieval-augmented generation systems, and is suitable for general-purpose conversational<br>
use, instruction-following, and other natural language and multimodal tasks. It is released with<br>
open weights to support research, fine-tuning and integration into third-party products by<br>
downstream developers.</p>
<h3>TIPSv2</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622237135-2d9f21e5-05f8-4c36-93ef-22f03c089f52.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Y3EuuwNIloIMdHTHNWaOcGs0gEytZlGOMsdP6bnbxHw"><img width="1555" height="1306" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622237135-2d9f21e5-05f8-4c36-93ef-22f03c089f52.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Y3EuuwNIloIMdHTHNWaOcGs0gEytZlGOMsdP6bnbxHw" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 1306px;"></a>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/tipsv2" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add TIPSv2 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4572374402" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46347" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347">#46347</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Ternura143/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Ternura143">@Ternura143</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347/hovercard">#46347</a></li>
</ul>
<h3>TIPSv2 DPT</h3>
<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622237398-09c0d4da-6c1c-4229-bf02-a512ed435e50.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..w3K0duMzhnPBpqupC4d8azAqwfq1tHVmova1NjfuWRc"><img width="794" height="245" alt="image" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/48595927/622237398-09c0d4da-6c1c-4229-bf02-a512ed435e50.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..w3K0duMzhnPBpqupC4d8azAqwfq1tHVmova1NjfuWRc" content-type-secured-asset="image/png" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 245px;"></a>
<p><strong>Links:</strong> <a href="https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/main/en/model_doc/tipsv2_dpt" rel="nofollow">Documentation</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Add TIPSv2 (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4572374402" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/46347" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347">#46347</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Ternura143/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/Ternura143">@Ternura143</a> in <a href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/46347/hovercard">#46347</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>🚨  Breaking changes</h2>
<p>GPTNeoX now remaps <code>embed_out</code> to <code>lm_head</code> and GPTBigCode has <code>_supports_attention_backend = True</code> enabled for vLLM compatibility; users relying on the previous weight naming or attention backend behavior for these models should update their code accordingly.</p>
<ul>
<li>🚨 Fix GPTBigCode and GPTNeoX for the Transformers modelling backend for vLLM (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4844223132" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/issues/47198" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/huggingface/transformers/pull/47198/hovercard" href="https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/47198">#47198</a>) by <a class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/hmellor/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self" href="https://github.com/hmellor">@hmellor</a></li>
</ul>
<h2>Kernels</h2>
<p>Several kernel-related fixes and improvements were made, including pinning the <code>kernels</code> dependency to a compatible version in the benchmark workflow, removing a deprecated <code>package_name</code> argument from <code>LocalLayerRepository</code>, and making the DeepGEMM Triton fallback more robust when <code>CUDA_HOME</code> is unset or misconfigured. Additionally, SDPA prefill was updated to leverage the FlashAttention kernel with <code>StaticCache</code>, yielding significant performance gains (up to 260% faster for large input sizes).</p>
<ul>
